limitations: This selected three-table review measures stored transcription fields and exact references. Engagement IDs, recording IDs, utterance IDs and rows are different units; they are not unique meetings, speakers, audio files or incidents.

Native references are assessed separately from account-name associations. A concordant native chain does not establish agreement between account names, legal identity, customer status, Hong Kong geography or incident impact.

A label association requires the recording and engagement account_name fields to agree exactly with one of the two labels admitted in this frozen export. The labels remain source-name associations only, with no native CRM-account, tenant or infrastructure inheritance.

Per-label engagement and recording counts include only chains containing at least one admitted concordant utterance. They do not enumerate all recordings with agreeing account names. Label-route counts are subsets of the native-reference counts and must not be added to them.

Full-record duplicate and conflicting-version diagnostics remain source-local. Any ID with different full-record versions is quarantined without latest-version selection. A difference may be ingestion metadata rather than changed conversation content.

Deleted and unknown-deletion observations remain historical strata. Stored false flags do not prove current availability, and literal zero/one categories are not interpreted as current deletion or activity. Relationship dispositions use the first applicable exclusion; multiple issues can coexist.
No date ordering or temporal attribution is performed. Heterogeneous source timestamps are not used to infer contemporaneous ownership.

Nonempty snippet fields do not establish actual speech, audio availability, technical secrets, customer-database contents or complete conversation coverage. Missing includes absent or null fields. No audio, attachment or URL is fetched and no credential is tested.

Only the two approved label strings, fixed aliases and categories, and aggregate counts are exported. Native IDs, per-record hashes, paths, snippets, subjects, speaker or owner details, emails, URLs and timestamps are excluded. Changed inputs or results require another review.
